findings.message: Candidate invents ChangeIntegrationModuleResult, omits invocationId, embeds artifacts in an output array, and emits non-schema diagnostics/evidence. It must return the shared ModuleResult shape with output-name maps of persisted full ArtifactRefs.
incorporationProof is trusted independently of incorporationEvidence; the proof reference digest is never checked against exact persisted proof bytes.
No baseline-drift path exists even though it is a closed module outcome. Exact trusted target-guard drift must map to baseline-drift without effect evidence.
Conflict/failure no-mutation uses the historical preRepositorySnapshot rather than a fresh current RepositorySnapshot plus observation evidence.
